news.title: CEO to Highlight Strategy at HC Wainwright Conference
news.text: Lightbridge announced CEO Seth Grae would join a fireside chat at HC Wainwright's Powering the Future virtual conference on July 15 to discuss advanced fuel initiatives.

news.title: Lightbridge Fabricates Enriched Uranium-Zirconium Samples
news.text: The company successfully fabricated nuclear material samples using enriched uranium-zirconium alloy for testing in Idaho National Laboratory's Advanced Test Reactor.

news.title: Lightbridge and Oklo Explore Additional Co-Location Opportunities
news.text: Lightbridge and Oklo agreed to evaluate additional co-location sites that could convert legacy nuclear materials into advanced fuels.

news.title: Lightbridge Issues Q2 2025 Business Update
news.text: Lightbridge reported second-quarter 2025 results, highlighting progress on fuel development programs and regulatory engagement.

news.title: CEO Set to Speak at Atlantic Council Summit
news.text: Lightbridge said Seth Grae will participate in the Atlantic Council Nuclear Energy Policy Summit in New York on September 24 to discuss advanced fuel policy.

news.title: Valuation Spotlight Following S&P Index Interest
news.text: Simply Wall St examined Lightbridge's valuation after new S&P index additions increased investor attention to advanced nuclear names.

news.title: Lightbridge Completes Capsule Loading for ATR Experiment
news.text: The company finished loading capsules containing Lightbridge fuel material samples into an experiment assembly for irradiation testing at the Advanced Test Reactor.
